_comment: Dev/test range only: 8501-8509. Production is ALWAYS port 8510, launched only via run_app.bat (which kills-and-restarts on that port) - never add 8510 or anything outside 8501-8509 here. Any session doing manual live-verification must pick one of the named slots below rather than inventing a port ad hoc (2026-08-06, after a port-sprawl leak - see Panga/CLAUDE.md's 'Be proactive, not reactive' section). If you need a slot and all of these are in use, that's a signal to finish and preview_stop an existing one, not to freelance a new port.

configurations._comment: Reserved exclusively for Release Manager's merge-verification live-checks (added 2026-08-06 after a port-kill incident on a shared slot). No other session should use this port.
